title: Natural target-stalk comparison with fixed pulled-back coefficients
statement: For a commutative ring Λ, arbitrary scheme morphisms p:X→S and g:T→S, integer q, sheaf F of Λ-modules on T_et and x∈X, set W=T×_S X, B=Over.pullback(pr_T), G=pr_T^*F [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. There exist isomorphisms E_U from baseChangeTargetStalk(U) [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions] to the stalk at x of R^q(B(U)→W→X)_*((B(U)→W)^*G), for every U in Over T. For each φ:U→V, baseChangeTargetStalkMap(φ) followed by E_U equals E_V followed by the higherDirectImageOverMap stalk transition along B(φ) [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. No affineness, compactness, limit, or zero-detection hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Construct the canonical scheme map from the iterated pullback to the single pullback and its inverse using pullback.lift. Check the two inverse identities projection by projection. The lowerStarPlusTransition along this map is an isomorphism by lowerStarPlusTransition_eq_baseChange and isIso_baseChange_app_of_inverses. Compose the exact single-complex comparison baseChangeTargetFunctorIso, this transition, and the coefficient isomorphism made from upperStarComp. This gives the explicit baseChangeTargetSheafComparison, with no sorry and no chosen existence witness.

Apply the geometric stalk functor to the explicit sheaf comparison. Apply the same functor to its restriction-coherence identity; functoriality maps its two composites to the required square. Package these mapped isomorphisms as the existential family.

baseChangeTargetFunctorIso in Coefficients identifies the single-complex target with the higher image. No natural comparison for iterated pullback stalk systems. Geometry follows directly from Mathlib overPullbackMap, IsPullback.paste_vert, isAffineHom_π_app and preservation of connected limits.

lean.statement: theorem baseChange_target_stalk_higher_image_comparison (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S) (q : ℤ) (F : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (x : X) : let B := Over.pullback (pullback.fst g p) let G := ((pullback.fst g p)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F ∃ E : ∀ U : Over T, baseChangeTargetStalk Λ p g q F x U ≅ (X.uliftPointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj (higherDirectImage Λ ((B.obj U).hom ≫ pullback.snd g p) q ((((B.obj U).hom)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj G)), ∀ (U V : Over T) (φ : U ⟶ V), baseChangeTargetStalkMap Λ p g q F x φ ≫ (E U).hom = (E V).hom ≫ (X.uliftPointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.map (higherDirectImageOverMap Λ (pullback.snd g p) G q (B.map φ))
